# ui::PathFigure

Header: `winui/render/PathGeometry.hpp`.

One figure of a geometry: a start point, its segments, whether the last point joins the first and whether the inside is painted.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::PathGeometry triangle;
triangle.figures.push_back(ui::PathFigure{
    .start    = ui::Point{0, 10},
    .segments = {{.p1 = ui::Point{5, 0}}, {.p1 = ui::Point{10, 10}}},
    .closed   = true,
});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | `Point` |  | Where the first segment begins, in DIPs. |
| `segments` | `std::vector<PathSegment>` |  | Each segment continues from the previous end point. |
| `closed` | `bool` | `false` | Join the last point back to `start` when stroking. |
| `filled` | `bool` | `true` | Whether the figure's inside is painted by a fill. |
